record.paper_title: Initial boundary value problem for Korteweg-de Vries equation: a review and open problems
record.original_question: For the pure initial value problem for the Korteweg-de Vries equation on the whole line, u_t + u u_x + u_xxx = 0 with x,t in R and initial data u(x,0) = phi(x), is the problem well-posed in H^s(R) for any s < -3/4? The source states that well-posedness is known for s >= -3/4 and that below this threshold the solution map is known not to be uniformly continuous, but it still identifies well-posedness below s = -3/4 as open.

evidence.quote: For the pure initial value problems (IVP) of the KdV equation posed on the whole line R or on torus T, (4.20) ut +uux +uxxx = 0, u(x,0) = φ(x), x,t ∈ R
Whether the IVP (4.20) is well-posed in the space Hs (R) for any s < −3/4 or the IVP (4.21) is well-posed in the space Hs (T) for any s < −1 is still an open question.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the pure initial value problem for the Korteweg–de Vries equation on the whole real line:
  u_t + u u_x + u_{xxx} = 0,   (x,t) ∈ ℝ × ℝ,
  u(x,0) = φ(x),
with initial data φ in the L²-based Sobolev space H^s(ℝ) of tempered distributions whose Fourier transform satisfies ∫(1+|ξ|²)^s |φ̂(ξ)|² dξ < ∞.

By "well-posed in H^s(ℝ)" we mean: for every φ ∈ H^s(ℝ) there exists a time T = T(‖φ‖_{H^s}) > 0 and a unique solution u ∈ C([0,T]; H^s(ℝ)) of the equation (in an appropriate distributional sense), and the data-to-solution map φ ↦ u is continuous from H^s(ℝ) to C([0,T]; H^s(ℝ)).

It is known that the problem is well-posed in H^s(ℝ) for s ≥ −3/4, and that for s < −3/4 the data-to-solution map fails to be uniformly continuous on bounded sets.

Question: Is the initial value problem well-posed in H^s(ℝ) for some (equivalently, every) s in the range s < −3/4?
artifact.status_search_result: Killip and Vișan (Annals of Mathematics, 2019; arXiv:1802.04851) proved that the KdV equation on ℝ is globally well-posed for initial data in H^{-1}(ℝ), which is sharp in the H^s scale and in particular settles well-posedness for all s in the range -1 ≤ s < -3/4. Thus the question raised in the review (posed before that work appeared in print) has been answered affirmatively down to s = -1.

status_evidence.title: KdV is wellposed in H^{-1} (arXiv)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove global well-posedness of the Korteweg–de Vries equation for initial data in the space H^{-1}(R). This is sharp in the class of H^s(R) spaces; even local well-posedness was previously unknown for s<-3/4.
status_evidence.claim: KdV is globally well-posed on ℝ in H^{-1}, covering all s in (-1, -3/4).

status_evidence.title: KdV is well-posed in H^{-1} | Annals of Mathematics
status_evidence.claim: Result published in Annals of Mathematics in 2019.
